what: ROADMAP 2.221 m1/m1b subset (LANE_REPORT_SAMPLE control, not the frozen sample): Litolff p1 (tempo mark) + p4 (the ff), Brahms p0 (hand truth) + p5
method: random.Random(seed); for plate in (litolff, brahms): sorted(rng.sample(sorted(candidates), n))
context: each plate also loads its OPENING page (the first candidate): the meter / key / clef printed there are inherited by every later bar (a change HOLDS until the printed return), and a slice without it cannot size a whole rest. Context pages are loaded but never counted.
